acceptanceCriteria: The unsupported-object-alternates refusal prints the repack-and-remove remediation, and DOGFOOD.md mentions it.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from agent friction. Parallel agents clone with `git clone --reference` to save disk space. `make dogfood-change` then refuses with unsupported-object-alternates, and the agent has to find out on its own that `git repack -a -d` followed by removing .git/objects/info/alternates fixes it. The refusal is reasonable, but it gives no remediation, and DOGFOOD.md does not mention it.
